entities.summary: Karl Wilhelm Konrad Arwe was a Swedish ice hockey player, bandy player, and footballer who competed in the 1920 Summer Olympics and in the 1924 Winter Olympics. He was born in Ölserud, Sweden and grew up in Stockholm, Sweden.
